summary: Shows passing vars and tags to roles under `roles:`, including the same role twice with different vars. A tag on a role applies to all its tasks; also tag pre/post tasks and dependencies. Before ansible-core 2.15 role vars leaked into play scope (controlled by DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROLE_VARS); newer versions don't.
questions: How do I pass variables to a role in the roles section?
If I tag a role, which tasks get the tag?
Do vars I pass to a role become available to the rest of the play?
Why do my role tags skip my pre_tasks?

answer_card.title: Pass vars and tags to roles
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- hosts: webservers
  roles:
    - common
    - role: foo_app_instance
      vars:
        dir: '/opt/a'
        app_port: 5000
      tags: typeA
    - role: foo_app_instance
      vars:
        dir: '/opt/b'
        app_port: 5001
      tags: typeB
```
- A tag on a role applies to **all** tasks in the role. If you use tags with role tasks, also tag your `pre_tasks`, `post_tasks`, and role dependencies.
- Before `ansible-core` 2.15, `vars:` in `roles:` were added to play variables (visible before and after the role), changeable via `DEFAULT_PRIVATE_ROLE_VARS`. In newer versions they don't leak into the play scope.
